metadata.description: ObsidianRutine - an Obsidian vault set up as a portable AI brain for Claude Code, installed by one skill

plugins.name: obsidian-rutine
plugins.description: Installs Obsidian and git if missing, creates the vault structure, configures Obsidian (plugins, templates, daily notes, auto-backup), links Claude Code's config and memory into the vault, installs the vault skill that keeps pushing knowledge into it, and reports exactly what is still missing.
